agent.reasons: Goran Rahman is a politically exposed person. He is the control person and a 23% owner, so 4.3 requires escalation to EDD. Ownership is also incomplete: 30% is unaccounted for and could belong to someone with 20% or more, which under 3.3 would be a request for documents. Under 2.1 the more severe outcome, escalate, governs. All other checks pass: the registry filing is about 6 months old, the industry is normal, every party is in the US, there are no sanctions or adverse media hits, every identified individual is verified, and Delta's owners each hold less than 20% indirectly (about 10.3% and 13.7%).
still_needed: Who holds the 30% of shares not accounted for (the documents needed to complete beneficial ownership under 3.3)
